## 1.3.39 (HexGhoul): fixes: NPCs stay put while you talk to them; nobody suffocates in blocks while holding your hand; wild ghouls fight back in creative, so their kagune shows (testing)
HexKagune 1.3.39 for Forge 1.20.1. Install on client and server (**protocol 67**, unchanged). Testing build: compiled, tests pass, **not tried in game**.

- **They don't walk off mid-talk.** A companion or wild ghoul stopped holding still 30 seconds after your last click, even with the talk still open, and could then walk away. Children never held still for a talk at all. Now each stays put and faces you for as long as the talk is open on your screen (within 10 blocks). A companion's idle wandering also waits while you talk.
- **No more suffocating while holding hands.** Anyone you hold (your spouse hand in hand; a child by the hand, in your arms or on your shoulders, or held by their NPC parent) no longer collides with blocks while held. They stay at your side through walls and can't choke in them. When you let go, they're solid again, and if that's inside a wall they're set down on your feet instead.
- **Wild ghouls show their kagune again (in creative).** The likely cause: wild ghouls never treated a player in creative mode as prey, even after being hit. So when you test in creative they never fought, and never brought out their Rinkaku tails or the new arm blade. Now a ghoul you hit fights back even in creative (its blows still can't hurt you there), so you see its kagune. It still never goes for a creative player unprovoked. If you were in survival when they didn't show, tell me and I'll dig further.

Untested in game: compiled and unit tested only. Try: open a talk and wait a minute; walk hand in hand along a wall or through a doorway; in creative, hit `/kagune npc rinkaku` and `/kagune npc koukaku`.
